subject.title: fix: drain inbound debounce buffer and followup queues before SIGUSR1 reload

question: Should restart-drain bypasses remain private core plumbing, or should this PR intentionally expose them as a supported plugin SDK capability?
rationale: The current diff changes exported SDK queue types, and deciding whether third-party plugins may bypass gateway-draining admission is a compatibility and security-boundary choice rather than a routine code repair.

options.title: Keep Bypass Private
options.body: Remove the public SDK bypass methods/options and route restart-drain work through core-owned runtime internals or injected non-SDK handles.

options.title: Approve SDK Surface
options.body: Explicitly support the new plugin-facing bypass API with documentation, compatibility tests, and a clear security model for who may call it.

options.title: Pause This Branch
options.body: Hold or replace this dirty PR if the durable queue-persistence work is the preferred restart-recovery direction instead.

recommendation.title: Keep Bypass Private
recommendation.body: Remove the public SDK bypass methods/options and route restart-drain work through core-owned runtime internals or injected non-SDK handles.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this owner to both the shared channel run queue and followup/session delivery surface involved in the SDK boundary choice.
